name: University of Sydney General Bursary
summary: Non-repayable bursary for domestic University of Sydney students in genuine, immediate financial hardship.
key: Worth up to $2000 per semester, depending on available funds.
who: Domestic student currently enrolled at the University of Sydney
Evidence of genuine and immediate financial hardship
Satisfactory progress (generally a WAM of at least 50)
how: Submit a general bursary application through Sydney Student
Include supporting documents including a recent 30-day bank transaction history
catches: No more than two general bursaries in the same calendar year
Available all year; you may apply once per semester
Commencing students applying before census date may receive up to $1000
